plan_needed: An active MYOB Business Lite, Pro or AccountRight subscription. Must be done by the business owner (the Owner user in the MYOB Business file). This only permits a connection; someone still has to connect from Claude or ChatGPT.

steps.do: Sign in to My Account
steps.see: Your MYOB account home

steps.do: If you have several MYOB businesses, choose the one you want to allow AI access to
steps.see: That business is selected

steps.where: My Account, quick links on the right
steps.do: Click Manage AI connections
steps.see: The AI connections area

steps.do: Click AI file access
steps.see: A list of your businesses

steps.do: Find the business you want to connect
steps.see: Options for Claude and ChatGPT

steps.do: Choose to allow access for Claude, ChatGPT or both
steps.see: Access is allowed. Nothing is connected yet: a user still connects from Claude or ChatGPT

plan_needed: Owner must first allow Claude in My Account (myob-owner-allows-ai-access). Any user with access to the MYOB Business file, with their own Claude account and MYOB username and password. MYOB Business Lite, Pro or AccountRight subscription. On Claude Team or Enterprise, an Owner or Primary Owner must first enable the connector for the organisation. Beta, rolling out gradually.

steps.do: Open the Connectors directory in your Claude account
steps.see: The list of available connectors (on a Claude Team plan without permission to enable connectors, you see a Request button that goes to your Owners)

steps.do: Search for MYOB, then click Connect to Claude
steps.see: MYOB's sign-in, if you're not already signed in

steps.do: If prompted, enter your MYOB username and password
steps.see: MYOB asks which business file to connect, if you have more than one

steps.do: Choose the MYOB Business file you want to connect
steps.see: A connection confirmation

steps.do: Click Done
steps.see: MYOB is connected. In a chat, use + > Connectors to switch it on or off for that conversation

plan_needed: Owner must first allow ChatGPT in My Account (myob-owner-allows-ai-access). Any user with access to the MYOB Business file, with their own ChatGPT subscription and MYOB username and password. MYOB Business Lite, Pro or AccountRight subscription. MYOB names no ChatGPT plan; OpenAI's plan and workspace-admin rules could not be confirmed.

steps.do: Open Plugins in your ChatGPT account
steps.see: The plugin directory

steps.do: Search for MYOB, then click Install plugin (OpenAI's general guide describes opening the plugin's details and selecting the plus button)
steps.see: MYOB's sign-in, if you're not already signed in, and the plugin's requested permissions to review

steps.do: If prompted, enter your MYOB username and password
steps.see: MYOB asks which business file to connect, if you have more than one

steps.do: Choose the MYOB Business file you want to connect
steps.see: A connection confirmation

steps.do: Click Done
steps.see: MYOB is installed

steps.do: Select the MYOB plugin before each question
steps.see: Answers come from your MYOB data. If MYOB isn't selected, ChatGPT defaults to a web search

plan_needed: No official connection exists; this copies a report out of MYOB. Needs access to the report in MYOB, desktop Excel 2010 or later for MYOB's Excel export, and a Microsoft 365 subscription that includes Copilot.

steps.do: Open the report you want, such as Profit and Loss
steps.see: The report on screen

steps.do: Optionally filter it or add, remove or reorder columns
steps.see: The report as you want it exported

steps.do: Choose Excel, then click Export
steps.see: An Excel file saves to your Downloads folder

steps.do: Open the file and select the Copilot icon in the lower-right corner
steps.see: Copilot opens in Allow editing mode

steps.do: Choose Allow editing, Plan or Chat only, then ask your question
steps.see: Copilot answers from the copied report. Nothing changes in MYOB

plan_needed: No official connection exists; this copies a report out of MYOB. Needs access to the report in MYOB and a Google account signed in to Gemini Apps. Up to 10 files per prompt, 100 MB per file.

steps.do: Open the report you want, then from the Export menu choose Excel or PDF and click Export
steps.see: Excel saves to Downloads; a PDF opens in a new browser tab to download

steps.do: Type your prompt, click Add files, then Upload files
steps.see: Your device's file picker

steps.do: Choose the exported file
steps.see: The file is attached to your prompt

steps.do: Click Submit
steps.see: Gemini answers from the uploaded copy. The file counts toward your Gemini Apps activity storage

plan_needed: MYOB Developer Program membership (cheapest listed tier $110 a month including GST; no free API access mentioned). An online MYOB Business or AccountRight company file. A MYOB administrator must approve consent for one company file. Bound by MYOB's Developer Program and Platform Terms, which bar training AI on MYOB data and bar MCP servers that wrap MYOB's API for outside AI agents.

steps.do: Join the Developer Program: choose a level and fill in the form
steps.see: MYOB processes your membership

steps.do: Submit the registration form for API access
steps.see: MYOB sets up a my.MYOB login and invites you to a sandbox company file

steps.do: Click Register App, enter the app name and redirect URL, then click Register App
steps.see: Your API key and secret appear, with usage and quota details

steps.do: Send the user to MYOB's sign-in page, requesting only the granular scopes the app needs (for example sme-sales)
steps.see: MYOB's consent screen listing the requested access

steps.do: A MYOB administrator approves consent for a single company file
steps.see: MYOB returns a code and a businessId to the app

steps.do: Exchange the code for an access token, then call the API with the token, API key and company file credentials
steps.see: The app can read and, where scopes allow, create, update or delete records
